messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 2):
"""
5 Policy Coverage (What the policy covers?) (Policy Clause Number/s) Expenses in respect of: Admission in Hospital beyond xx hrs Pre-hospitalisation (treatment prior to admission in hospital) of xx days amounting to x% of claim Post-hospitalisation (treatment after discharge from hospital) within xx days from date of discharge amounting to x% of claim. Specified / Listed procedures requiring less than xx hours of hospitalization (day care) Undergoing specified procedure in case of xx Critical illnesses Diagnosis of an illness of specified severity Daily cash benefit of Rs. per day during admission in hospital OPD / Dental/ Maternity coverage Emergency or Travel Medical Assistance Personal Accident Cover Travel Cover (Note: This is an indicative list. Insurer must ensure that all the benefits of the policy are listed above) 6 Exclusions (what the policy does not cover) (Note:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What is the maximum duration for pre‑hospitalisation coverage and how much of the claim does it cover?","answer":"Pre‑hospitalisation coverage applies to treatment prior to admission in hospital for up to xx days and covers x% of the claim.","facts":["Pre-hospitalisation (treatment prior to admission in hospital) of xx days amounting to x% of claim"]},{"question":"How long after discharge can post‑hospitalisation treatment be claimed and what percentage of the claim is covered?","answer":"Post‑hospitalisation coverage is available within xx days from the date of discharge and covers x% of the claim.","facts":["Post-hospitalisation (treatment after discharge from hospital) within xx days from date of discharge amounting to x% of claim"]}]}
